rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a verbal quarrel or dispute.

example.english: I don't want to have an argument with anyone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 jan4 naau6 gaau1

rows.note: Use this for a reason or statement offered to support a claim, rather than for a quarrel.

example.english: This argument is not strong enough to convince people.
example.traditional: 呢個理由唔夠充分，說服唔到人。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lei5 jau4 m4 gau3 cung1 fan1 syut3 fuk6 m4 dou2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a formal logical argument made up of premises leading to a conclusion.

example.english: This argument moves from three premises to a final conclusion.
example.traditional: 呢個論證由三個前提推到最後嘅結論。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 leon6 zing3 jau4 saam1 go3 cin4 tai4 teoi1 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 ge3 git3 leon6
